transcript: Mard, 40 saal. Kal raat se dast hai. Aankh lal dapha hai. Dast nahi hai. Jism par daane ek mahina. HB 8. Dast ke waqt. Duphaston 400 din mein teen baar, 5 din. Doodh aur dahi kam. Balgham lagatar. Lyrica band karwa lein. Do hafte baad dikhayein.

findings: skin lesions on body for 1 month

medications.name: Duphaston
medications.instructions: take with milk and curd, avoid balgham
